name: slack
title: Slack
description: Editable raw Slack readers with recent overlapping message ranges and checkpoints after complete history pages and replies.

changes: Use one installation pipeline with independently selectable channels, users, and messages streams and unchanged raw tables and scoped record identities.
Default messages to a recent 24-hour bootstrap, then overlap the completed watermark by 24 hours; allow explicit historyFrom bootstrap coverage and isolated bounded backfills.
Checkpoint fixed windows and complete history pages after all their selected replies load; replay an interrupted page without durable thread queues or child cursors.
Reuse full paginate pages and native has_more metadata with exact timestamp frontiers and bounded temporary-cursor replay; reject incompatible strategy state explicitly.
Document that old edits and late replies on roots outside the selected range are outside normal coverage; remove periodic historical reconciliation and include portable recovery fixtures.
Add provider logo presentation metadata; distributed source is unchanged.
Introduce raw conversations, users, messages, and thread replies with configurable conversation selection and request pacing.

resources.name: channels
resources.title: Conversations
resources.description: Selected accessible conversations, including archived channels, with complete returned topics, purpose, membership flags, and shared-channel metadata. Public channels by default; private channels, DMs, and group DMs are opt-in.

resources.name: users
resources.title: Users
resources.description: Complete returned workspace member and bot profiles, IDs, names, status, timezone, and deactivation flags. Email requires the optional users:read.email scope.

resources.name: messages
resources.title: Messages and thread replies
resources.description: Raw messages selected by recent overlapping timestamp windows, plus replies belonging to selected roots. History-page progress commits after every selected reply is loaded. Old roots outside the range are not revisited; timestamps remain exact strings.

authentication.method: Slack OAuth bearer token (user token recommended)
setup: Create a Slack app for the workspace at api.slack.com/apps. Open OAuth & Permissions.
Add channels:read, channels:history, and users:read under User Token Scopes for the default three streams. Add users:read.email only when emails are needed.
For private channels add groups:read and groups:history; for DMs add im:read and im:history; for group DMs add mpim:read and mpim:history. Enable the matching conversationTypes in config.ts.

Install or reinstall the app to the workspace and copy the User OAuth Token into SLACK_API_TOKEN in the project .env or scheduler secret environment. A bot token only reads conversations it can access; enabled thread replies must also be permitted.
Keep tokens outside version control. Supply token refresh separately when using expiring tokens; the integration does not manage OAuth issuance or refresh.

sync.description: Channels and users are full reads. Messages initially select the recent 24 hours unless historyFrom is set, then overlap the completed watermark by 24 hours. Each history page and all its selected replies finish before its timestamp frontier commits. Temporary cursors and child progress are not persisted; old-root replies and old edits outside the selected range are outside normal coverage.
sync.schedule: Run chkit ingest run through cron, CI, or an existing scheduler, with one process per project/target. Interrupted message windows keep their fixed bounds and replay the incomplete history page; users/channels restart full reads. One history page and all its replies must fit the execution budget. Conservative message pacing remains 15 items and one request per minute.
sync.deletions: Later observations replace stable row IDs, but deleted, inaccessible, or deselected records remain. The integration does not consume Slack events, propagate deletions, or maintain a complete change log.
